article.story: Clemson (6-4) at Duke (7-3), Nov. 20 at 7:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Duke by 12.5. Against the spread: Duke 8-2, Clemson 4-6. How to watch: ESPN Key stats Duke Offense Overall: 416.7 yards per game (36th in FBS) Passing: 232.2 yards per game (59th) Rushing: 184.5 yards per game (38th) Scoring: 32.2 points per game (35th) Duke Defense Overall: 307.1 yards per game (24th in FBS) Passing: 206.1 yards per game (61st) Rushing: 101 yards per game (17th) Scoring: 15.3 points per game (13th) Clemson Offense Overall: 327 yards per game (122nd in FBS) Passing: 180.6 yards per game (118th) Rushing: 146.4 yards per game (83rd) Scoring: 21 points per game (115th) Clemson Defense Overall: 342.1 yards per game (47th in FBS) Passing: 205.1 yards per game (57th) Rushing: 137 yards per game (59th) Scoring: 20.6 points per game (33rd) Clemson is 134th in third down percentage, converting 29.8% of the time. Duke ranks 6th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 28.9%. Clemson ranks 81st in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:40, compared to Duke's 29th-ranked average of 31:40. Team leaders Duke Passing: Walker Eget, 2,044 yards, 11 TDs, 4 INTs, 62.8 completion percentage Rushing: Nate Sheppard, 1,320 yards on 207 carries, 19 TDs Receiving: Sheppard, 399 yards on 44 catches, 4 TDs Clemson Passing: Tait Reynolds, 1,449 yards, 3 TDs, 4 INTs, 64.7 completion percentage Rushing: Gideon Davidson, 528 yards on 105 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Bryant Wesco Jr., 536 yards on 47 catches, 0 TDs Last game Duke was beaten by Miami (FL) 36-25 on Nov. 14. Eget passed for 195 yards on 26-of-42 attempts (61.9%) with one touchdown and one interception. Sheppard had 131 rushing yards on 16 carries and two touchdowns, adding 12 receptions for 93 yards. Jonah Burton had four receptions for 46 yards. Clemson lost 20-6 to Georgia Tech on Nov. 14. Christopher Vizzina passed for 133 yards on 12-of-27 attempts (44.4%) with no touchdowns and one interception. Jarvis Green had 39 rushing yards on 13 carries, adding two receptions for 15 yards. Juju Preston put up 56 yards on four catches. Next game Duke plays at No. 10 Wake Forest on Nov. 28. Clemson hosts South Carolina on Nov. 28.
